entry.title: Factory Smokes Sweet Toro — Single
experienceTags: Occasion: Sweet short session, dessert smoke, casual evening
entry.summaryHtml: Creamy sweetness, coffee, vanilla and mild toasted tobacco give the Factory Smokes Sweet Toro an easygoing dessert profile. The sweet-capped Habano keeps the smoke sugary and aromatic, while coffee and light tobacco underneath stop it from reading as pure confection. The profile is mellow and straightforward rather than dark or forceful, with sweetness carrying most of the character.
practicalLines: Sweetened cap retained only on the head half
